source_caption_text:
YoungBoy almost became a Barb for a second 😭

Mike WiLL Made-It brought Nicki Minaj and NBA YoungBoy together for “What That Speed Bout?!” in 2020, marking the first official collaboration between the two rappers. Built around a fast-paced trap beat with bouncing synths and heavy drums, the track gives both artists room to bring their own style. YoungBoy handles the hook, while Nicki comes through with a confident verse full of sharp lines and playful references.

One funny moment comes when YoungBoy starts reciting Nicki’s lyrics and nearly calls himself a “bad lil b****” before catching himself. It’s a quick slip, but his reaction makes the moment even better, especially considering he’s rapping alongside Nicki herself. Little moments like that give the track some personality beyond the usual back-and-forth flexes.

The chemistry between the three artists makes “What That Speed Bout?!” an interesting collaboration to revisit. Mike WiLL’s production gives YoungBoy and Nicki a common ground, while their different approaches keep the song moving. And that brief moment where YoungBoy almost gets carried away with Nicki’s lyrics is still one of the funniest parts of the track. 

#nickiminaj #nbayoungboy #rap
